nodes.question: What is the primary focus of the New Silk Road (NSR) according to the article?
nodes.answer: The primary focus of the NSR is to reflect China’s globalization strategy, promoting greater economic openness through policy coordination, infrastructure connectivity, trade facilitation, financial cooperation, and people-to-people contacts.
